title: Zelenskyy Orders Probe Following Internal Clash Between Ukrainian Security Agencies
snippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced a full investigation after a rare confrontation between two state security services, calling for unity and strict discipline.
content:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that a formal investigation is underway following a rare clash between two of the country's security agencies, underscoring potential internal tensions within Kyiv's security apparatus.

Addressing Internal Friction

While official details regarding the specific agencies involved and the exact nature of the altercation remain sparse, Zelenskyy made it clear that internal discord will not be tolerated during wartime. In his statement, the president stressed the necessity of strict discipline and seamless coordination among all branches of law enforcement and intelligence.

Focus on Accountability and National Security

Kyiv officials have moved to reassure the public and international allies that the incident has been contained and will not compromise ongoing defense operations. As law enforcement oversight bodies review the incident, senior leadership maintains that maintaining a unified front is paramount to national security.
